versionPairs.description: A real esbuild 0.28.2 `--bundle --minify-identifiers --format=iife --platform=node` build of the shared node-app source (test/e2e/fixtures/node-app). `--minify-identifiers` alone: every helper renamed, but whitespace and syntax kept, so the module helper's marker is the SPACED `{ exports: {} }` — neither the tight marker scan nor the `__commonJS` name finds it; the helper SHAPE does (spec I2). v1.1.0 perturbs the last dep (adds tripled), the late module's output and the lazy stamp.
